annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the OneCoin-branded stage presentation promotes cryptocurrency participation as a way to escape banks, preserve wealth and obtain a more prosperous financial future. The speaker urges viewers to get involved, frames hesitation as a costly missed opportunity illustrated by a friend with a new car, and asks them to bring other people into the movement. These claims and recruitment-oriented appeals present participation as a path to significant financial benefits rather than providing neutral market commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the presentation promotes OneCoin-associated cryptocurrency participation and links it to wealth preservation, financial freedom, and future financial gains. The talk is not merely discussing cryptocurrency markets: it uses direct calls to get involved and persuasive wealth-related examples to encourage participation. No specific purchase transaction or completed payout is shown, but the promotional pathway and claimed benefits are observable.
